0022600088.text: Toronto hosts Chicago in the Raptors' first game of the 2026-27 season, and both teams are opening their seasons with no games played yet. Brandon Ingram is out after Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle is day-to-day with a foot injury and a game-time decision. For Chicago, Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury, while Isaac Okoro (undisclosed), Tobe Awaka (knee), and Zach Collins (toe, after surgery) are day-to-day game-time decisions.
